data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出RPG框架，利用执行反馈诊断失败，改写系统提示并增改可复用符号技能，经跨任务评估后保留复用，属推理Harness持续自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures.
scope_support.object_quote: It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse.
